_meta.source: TB_AI_Audit_Final_Detailed_Team_Final.md sec 10.1 (India-specific compliance and reporting flags), sec 10.2 (CARO 2020 analytics support), sec 10.3 (Schedule III disclosure support), sec 10.4 (India-specific limitations)
_meta.purpose: Trial-balance keyword indicators mapped to the CARO 2020 area or Companies Act compliance head they may be relevant to, and the specific record that would let the audit team form a view.
_meta.safe_rule: The model may flag a TB indicator relevant to a CARO clause where CARO applies, but it MUST NOT conclude any CARO reporting matter from the trial balance. A keyword such as CSR, MSME, director loan, ICD, public deposit or GST payable is only a trigger to request the relevant statutory working -- never a finding of non-compliance. Output wording must be 'possible CARO-related indicator if CARO applies; request supporting records'.
_meta.applicability_gate: CARO applicability is NOT derivable from a trial balance. These indicators must only be surfaced when the engagement context confirms CARO applies (see entity/build_engagement_context). Absent that confirmation, they are reported as unconfirmed-applicability information requests.
_meta.amend_policy: Adding an indicator requires naming the exact record that resolves it. An indicator with no resolving record produces an alarm the audit team cannot act on.
_meta.matching: case_insensitive_substring against gl_name, main_head and sub_head_1

caro_2020_areas.area: Property, plant and equipment and intangible assets
evidence_to_request: Fixed asset register showing full particulars and situation of assets
Title deeds for immovable property held in the company's name
Physical verification programme and its results
Revaluation working and registered valuer's report
Details of proceedings under the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act
Physical verification of inventory with coverage and discrepancy summary
Quarterly stock statements filed with banks
Reconciliation of stock statements to books of account
Sanction letter for working-capital limits above INR 5 crore
Agreements stating terms, tenure and interest
Schedule of repayment and actual receipts
Directors' declarations for amounts received from directors
Return-wise reconciliation for each statutory levy
Challans evidencing payment and payment dates
Schedule of dues outstanding for more than six months from the due date
Disputed-dues schedule naming the forum where each dispute is pending
Lender-wise default details with period and amount
Journal dump for manual and year-end entries
Management explanation for each unresolved balance
Whistle-blower complaints received during the year
Any report filed in Form ADT-4
caro_2020_areas.caution: These are planning-stage risk indicators only. Reporting a fraud is a matter for the audit team acting under its own statutory responsibility -- never a model output.

evidence_to_request: Section 135 computation of the CSR obligation
Unspent CSR account details and transfer evidence
Transfer to a Schedule VII fund where applicable
Valuation support for any preferential issue
Evidence of transfer to the Unpaid Dividend Account
IEPF transfer evidence where over seven years
DIPAM guidance compliance for a Government company

companies_act_heads.trigger: Always evaluated -- this is an input-quality question, not a keyword match. Raised when the TB export carries no ERP report id, no export timestamp, or is an Excel-only extract.
evidence_to_request: Audit-trail (edit log) enablement report for the full year

schedule_iii_disclosures.cue: CWIP or intangible under development present
